note: Adjudicated variants: 6 accidental (punctuation, capitalization, capital-accents, accents). Substantive text agrees across both witnesses with zero further divergence.

adjudicated.ruling: No comma before the apposition Dómini nostri, with handmissal-eo and with the corpus ruling at ordinarium.suscipe-sancta-trinitas w016: ejúsdem Christi Fílii tui Dómini nostri is one unbroken title.
No comma between the title and the genitives it possesses, with handmissal-eo: tam beátæ passiónis depends on the same chain and is not parenthetical.
No comma before the ac joining the second ablative, with do and with the corpus rulings at ordinarium.confiteor w028 and ordinarium.lavabo w024: donis ac datis is one pair.

Lowercase, with handmissal-eo and with the typical edition. The capital in do marks the three blessings that fall on the word, which this edition carries as rubric segments instead. The same ruling governs w046 and w048.
